name: event.scout
description: Advisory. Judge a conference or meetup scouting run: are the CFPs real, dated, and matched to work RIG has actually delivered.

deadline_dated.instructions: Every candidate lists a submission deadline date, not a season or a guess

fit_evidenced.instructions: Fit is argued from a specific RIG deliverable or result, not from the event marketing copy

abstract_drafted.instructions: A draft abstract exists for at least one candidate

nothing_submitted.instructions: The run submitted nothing; submission stays a human action

rules.reason: an undated CFP list is unusable for planning
fit claim has no delivered work behind it

calibration.note: Authored 2026-10-05 by session GqYCYA10TAeQlT5l from the OpenDots expert rubric-gap census (both judges abstained on every existing rubric). Calibrate on labelled runs before enforcement. Advisory by construction: rules emit PASS or ESCALATE only, no BLOCK.

notes: Hub-approved (SP4ikIin7S6GmLBw, 2026-10-05): advisory rubrics with calibrated:false and never_auto so nothing can hard-BLOCK work.
